big_case.notes: Pro se paid petition from an unpublished D.C. Circuit order dismissing an NHTSA headlamp-rule challenge as untimely, with an alternative no-reviewable-action ground. The SG waived response, no amici, denied at first conference with no noted writing. The agency-inaction-versus-completed-rule question has some general administrative-law interest, but this vehicle and record give it little salience.
